title: Sealed config is never decrypted ad hoc; one budgeted call site only
intent: A sealed configuration value (``enc:v1:...``) stays opaque in app code: a module renders ``mask_config`` and never calls ``decrypt_config``. The single sanctioned decrypt site (design §5.4) carries a justified ``# arch-allow-no-adhoc-config-decrypt`` marker counted against the app's escape-hatch budget. Its runtime half is :func:`terp.core.secrets.decrypt_config`, which fails closed unless called from the one site registered via ``register_decrypt_call_site``.

runtime.rationale: decrypt_config itself fails closed on every path unless invoked from the single call site registered via register_decrypt_call_site -- an ad hoc decrypt raises SecretsError at runtime; the budgeted marker governs which site that is.
